review.notes: Word-level diff of the PDF text layer against the OCR markdown for all 6 physical pages; digit-sequence inventories compared; rendered physical p.6 at 300 dpi to verify the misread author name. Dropped words otherwise resolve to page footer numerals 1-6 (not reproduced by OCR) and two tokenizer artifacts (PDF prints 'non-existent' across a line break; 'capture-the-flag-style' hyphens lost by the text layer only). No unbalanced code fences, no spurious headings; bullet marker inconsistency is a source style artifact, not patched.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.6 reference line reads 'Kenny O Oseleononmen' (visually verified at 300 dpi); the PDF text layer also extracts Oseleononmen. OCR dropped one 'n' in the surname.
